rationale: Initial render leaves the selected full column disabled with tabindex0 and all remaining legal columns tabindex-1. focusColumn tries the disabled selected button. CPU-turn render can move focus outside the board, so Arrow/Enter do not reach board handler and Tab cannot regain a legal tabindex0 column. This blocks the specified keyboard interaction in an otherwise playable match. Current render replaces a full selected column with the first legal column before generating tabindex and CPU completion explicitly focuses it. Compiled CPU and same-device fill-column sequences still need measurement.
